title: Complete critical synthetic dry run
objective: Demonstrate complete Tier 3 readiness evidence without executing a destructive action.

scope.description: Synthetic Tier 3 dry-run readiness evaluation only.

non_goals: Execute any live or destructive action
requirements: All Tier 3 controls must be present and verified.
acceptance_criteria: The gate reports readiness PASS without executing the task.
assumptions: The target and evidence are synthetic.
alternatives: Do not perform the synthetic action
selected_design: Evaluate a fully controlled synthetic dry run.

rollback.procedure: Restore the independently verified synthetic recovery image.

factors.consequence: Readiness evaluation only; no execution authority.
factors.reversibility: Verified synthetic backup and rollback evidence are recorded.
factors.data_sensitivity: Only non-sensitive synthetic fixture data is used.
factors.operational_reach: Bounded to the local synthetic gate fixture.
factors.physical_effects: None; the evaluator never executes the described task.
factors.affected_party_impact: Taylor receives synthetic readiness evidence only.
factors.ai_socio_technical_risk: Human authority, misuse, and stop paths are recorded.

risk_analysis.summary: Synthetic critical readiness record with zero live blast radius.

evidence_freshness.basis: Identity checked by the current fixture suite.

data_governance.purpose: Exercise the gate with non-sensitive synthetic fixture metadata.
necessary_fields: Control status and synthetic evidence paths
data_governance.retention: Retain with the versioned governance test suite.
data_governance.deletion_or_archival_conditions: Archive with a superseded policy version.

threats: An incomplete record could bypass a readiness control.
mitigations: Fail-closed evaluator checks and adversarial tests.

expected_operating_range: Only controlled gate decisions are emitted.
alert_thresholds: Any policy, artifact, or evidence mismatch.
stop_thresholds: Unknown risk, unknown control state, or critical warning.
reassessment_triggers: Policy, schema, permission, dependency, or environment change.
monitoring.safe_degradation: Stop and report sanitized unmet requirements without executing the task.

unsupported_uses: Authorize or execute a configuration change.
ai_assurance.provenance: The deterministic gate and synthetic fixture are identified in this record.
foreseeable_misuse: Treating readiness PASS as execution authority.

quality.measure: All required functional controls are satisfied.

safety.measure: All required stop and recovery controls are satisfied.

security.measure: All required deterministic and security tests are satisfied.

fairness.measure: The synthetic fixture introduces no differentiated affected-party treatment.

ai_assurance.override_path: Taylor may stop before any separately authorized execution.
ai_assurance.stop_path: A BLOCKED or FAIL decision stops the workflow.
ai_assurance.fallback_path: Return sanitized unmet requirements without changing state.
ai_assurance.rollback_path: Restore the verified pre-change configuration after a separately authorized failed action.
monitoring_and_reassessment_triggers: Policy, artifact, permission, dependency, or environment drift.
ai_assurance.retirement_condition: Retire when the schema or policy version is superseded.
limitations: The fixture proves gate behavior, not evidence authenticity or human identity.

hazards.description: A synthetic readiness control could be bypassed.
hazards.control: Fail-closed evaluator checks and explicit stop conditions.

residual_risk.description: No live action occurs in this synthetic fixture.
